data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fahsa', meaning 'to be elegant', 'to be beautiful'. In Islamic culture, Fazeen symbolizes grace, beauty, and elegance. The name Fazeen carries the meaning “Elegant, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fazeen usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fazeen total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
